name: Peace Love Mahjong
description: Dallas mahjong shop with event space Where Dragons Play offering Mahjong 101 group lessons, guided play and open play. Evidence (Where Dragons Play event page): "for newer players who already know the basics of American Mahjong and are ready for more practice with an instructor nearby." Blog: "wildly popular in American homes thanks to the National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) rules."
schedule: Mahjong 101 group lessons (2.5 hr) listed at $60; guided play $40; open play $35; see wheredragonsplay.com for dated sessions
